narr: Afternoon monsoonal thunderstorms near the Davis Mountains resulted in localized flash flooding of low water crossings along the road to the Buffalo Trail Scout Ranch.
ev: A report from mPING was received of flash flooding. This report was likely a result of water across low water crossings along the road in and out of the Buffalo Trail Scout Ranch. Duration is an estimation.
lsr: Report from mPING: Street/road flooding; Street/road closed; Vehicles stranded.
